summary: Stamp duty on agreements-cum-sale vs conveyance; physical possession transfer clause converts agreement to conveyance equivalence; several instruments rule (Maharashtra Stamp Act s.4) does not apply across disparate transactions; Explanation I to Article 25 Schedule I governs deemed conveyance; documents impounded for deficient stamp duty; merged-agreement argument rejected; prior agreements not absorbed into subsequent registered sale deeds.
legal_provisions_cited: Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958 s.33, s.34, s.37, s.4
Maharashtra Stamp Act Schedule I Article 25 Explanation I
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding impounding of six documents for inadequate stamp duty affirmed; documents referred to Collector of Stamp for adjudication.
